note: Sources only recipes/build-ffmpeg-windows.sh needs, read after ffmpeg-sources.json (an entry there wins). macOS links the system zlib; Windows builds it from source. Same rules: a null or mismatched sha256 refuses the build.

evidence.statement: https://zlib.net/ (fetched 2026-10-11) lists this exact SHA-256 for zlib-1.3.2.tar.xz.
evidence.result: Observed digest equals the zlib.net statement. The OpenPGP signature was NOT checked (no gpg on the Windows build host).
